summary: The dark theme layout largely complies with system styling, but exhibits viewport clipping on smaller screens and awkward metadata text wrapping at the base of the page.

issues.title: Content truncated at viewport bottom
issues.description: The timeline preview container is clipped by the fold on a 360x640 viewport.
issues.evidence: The viewport screenshot cuts off the bottom card midway through the timeline tick marks.
issues.suggestion: Reduce vertical spacing between form elements to ensure the preview card remains visible without scrolling.

issues.title: Orphaned text wrap in footer
issues.description: Instructional text below the ruler breaks onto a second line with awkward phrasing.
issues.evidence: The string 'to pan' wraps awkwardly onto a standalone line beneath the comment count.
issues.suggestion: Adjust container padding or font styling to allow the metadata string to render on a single line.
